hebrewText: וּ/בִ/נְסֹ֣עַ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וּ/בַ/חֲנֹת֙ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖/וֹ הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/הַ/זָּ֥ר הַ/קָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת

tokens.bdb: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney
tokens.kjv: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.

tokens.bdb: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)

to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come(-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go(-ing) down(-ward), hang down, [idiom] indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanation: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanationEn: a Levite or descendant of Levi

tokens.bdb: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege)
tokens.kjv: abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

tokens.bdb: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)
to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
tokens.kjv: abide, accomplish, [idiom] be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, [idiom] be dim, endure, [idiom] enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, [idiom] but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, -rising).

tokens.bdb: to turn aside (especially for lodging); hence to be aforeigner, strange, profane; specifically (active participle) to commit adultery
tokens.kjv: (come from) another (man, place), fanner, go away, (e-) strange(-r, thing, woman).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.enLiteralWord: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.explanation: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.explanationEn: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner

tokens.bdb: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose
tokens.kjv: (cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cause to) draw near (nigh), go (near), be at hand, join, be near, offer, present, produce, make ready, stand, take.

tokens.bdb: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, [idiom] crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), [idiom] must needs, slay, [idiom] surely, [idiom] very suddenly, [idiom] in (no) wise.
